from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as C,os,sys,json,struct,hashlib
B=Path('/home/qian-qi/.local/state/hia-azi5-b843-qa/cleanup-audit-20261124T0745Z');V=B/'native-multiversion-source';sys.path.insert(0,str(V));os.chdir(V)
from tools.qualify_hia_multiversion_retirement import Pair
from tools.qualify_hia_multiversion_components import get
from hepta.hia_retirement_state_native import NativeRetirementImage,RetirementState
D=B/'native-multiversion-retirement-attested-v1';STATE=6<<20;ATTESTED=STATE+10240
q=Pair(D/'diagnostics-v2',B/'native-multiversion-image-v5');q.load();q.call(2)
flags=get(q.out,24);attested=bytes(q.out.raw[128:640]);assert q.out.raw[640:]==bytes(128)
assert C.string_at(C.addressof(q.f.work)+ATTESTED,512)==attested and get(q.f.work,4376)==1
stateflat=(D/'retirement_state.flat').read_bytes();image=NativeRetirementImage(stateflat,hashlib.sha256(stateflat).hexdigest())
oldlib=C.CDLL(str(B/'native-multiversion-retirement-v2/retirement-component.so'));old=oldlib.hia_mv_retire;old.argtypes=q.ret.argtypes;old.restype=q.ret.restype
rows=[]
def invoke(fn,work,magic=b'HIAMVRT2',op=2):
 raw=struct.pack('<8sQQ',magic,op,7);s=C.create_string_buffer(raw);out=C.create_string_buffer(b'\xa5'*768,768)
 rc=fn(s,len(raw),out,768,work,len(work));assert s.raw==raw+b'\0'
 return rc,out
fds=(get(q.f.work,32),get(q.f.work,48));ids=[(os.fstat(x).st_dev,os.fstat(x).st_ino) for x in fds]
for label,at in [('magic',0),('checksum',300),('nonce',440),('sequence',16)]:
 work=C.create_string_buffer(len(q.f.work));C.memmove(work,q.f.work,8<<20)
 initial=C.string_at(C.addressof(work)+STATE,4608);bad=bytearray(initial);bad[at]^=1
 C.memmove(C.addressof(work)+STATE,bytes(bad),len(bad))
 oracle=RetirementState(image,q.native_path,False);C.memmove(oracle._buffer,bytes(bad),len(bad))
 oracle._words=struct.unpack('<64Q',attested);oracle._flags=flags;oracle._owner=struct.unpack_from('<2Q',initial,440)
 expected,expectedflags=oracle.query();assert expectedflags==0 and oracle._fenced is not None
 rc,out=invoke(q.ret,work);assert rc==65 and out.raw[:8]==b'HIAMVTR2'
 assert struct.unpack('<64Q',out.raw[128:640])==expected and get(out,24)==expectedflags
 assert out.raw[128:640]==attested and get(out,640)==1 and get(out,56)==1
 assert C.string_at(C.addressof(work)+STATE,4608)==bytes(bad),'must not repair or replace damaged authority'
 assert get(work,4304)==0 and get(work,4320)==0
 first=out.raw;failedreply=first[648:736]
 # Once fenced, later corrupt bytes and policy output cannot replace first evidence.
 C.memset(C.addressof(work)+STATE,0x5a,4608);C.memset(C.addressof(work)+STATE+9000,0x5b,64)
 rc,out2=invoke(q.ret,work);assert rc==65 and out2.raw[128:640]==attested and get(out2,24)==0 and out2.raw[648:736]==failedreply
 rc,oldwire=invoke(q.ret,work,b'HIAMVRT1');assert rc==65 and oldwire.raw[:8]==b'HIAMVTR1' and oldwire.raw[128:640]==attested and oldwire.raw[640:]==bytes(128)
 assert ids==[(os.fstat(x).st_dev,os.fstat(x).st_ino) for x in fds] and q.native_path.exists()
 prior=C.create_string_buffer(len(q.f.work));C.memmove(prior,q.f.work,8<<20);C.memmove(C.addressof(prior)+STATE,bytes(bad),4608)
 oldrc,oldout=invoke(old,prior,b'HIAMVRT1');assert oldrc==65
 assert oldout.raw[128:640]!=attested or get(oldout,24)!=0,'counterfactual old implementation must demonstrate defect'
 row=dict(case=label,original_error=oracle._fenced,original_flags=expectedflags,native_flags=get(out,24),first_return=get(out,648),first_event=get(out,656),first_fence_reason=get(out,664),first_reply_hex=out.raw[672:736].hex(),last_attested_sha256=hashlib.sha256(attested).hexdigest(),counterfactual_old_flags=get(oldout,24),counterfactual_old_header_sha256=hashlib.sha256(oldout.raw[128:640]).hexdigest())
 rows.append(row);(D/(label+'.reply')).write_bytes(first);print('ATTESTED_GATE',label,row['original_error'],flush=True)
 del work,prior
# Actual original and native cleanup rights still belong only to their real unmodified holders.
q.call();q.call();q.finish_external()
report=dict(schema='hepta.hia.multiversion-retirement-last-attested.v1',whole_native_runtime=False,passed=len(rows),failed=0,actual_same_holder=True,old_wire_reserved_bytes_preserved=True,new_wire='HIAMVRT2/HIAMVTR2',image_sha256=hashlib.sha256((D/'retirement-component.so').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cases=rows)
(D/'attested-qualification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print('ATTESTED_PASS',len(rows),flush=True)
